list.title: Enrollments
list.emptyMessage: No enrollments found. Create your first enrollment to get started.

create.title: New Enrollment
create.name: Enrollment Name *
create.challengeRequired: Require challenge code on each authentication
create.errorCreate: Failed to create enrollment. Please try again.
create.previewNotice: Technology preview: this dialog shows the enrollment QR and binding challenge together for convenience. Production deployments would typically deliver these through separate channels (e.g. email and SMS) for stronger assurance—automated email/SMS integrations are not part of this release. This hosted build is a demonstrator, not a production security baseline. Until then, consider capturing the QR with a screen capture or screenshot tool and sending the image to the person enrolling, and sending the 6-digit binding challenge in a separate SMS to their phone using your usual channel.
create.qrHint: User can scan the QR code below to set up their device.

status.helpCreated: Enrollment created, waiting for device to bind.
status.helpVerified: Device verified and active for authentication.
status.helpInvalid: Verification failed; enrollment is permanently invalid.
status.helpRevoked: Enrollment permanently revoked by an administrator.
status.helpExpired: Enrollment expired past its expiration date.

keyTier.helpNone: The device reported that its private key is not stored in hardware-backed keystore (e.g. demo tools or software storage). This is client-reported, not attested by the server.
keyTier.helpStandard: The device reported hardware-backed keystore (e.g. Android Keystore / TEE without StrongBox). Client-reported.
keyTier.helpStrong: The device reported StrongBox or equivalent strongly isolated hardware. Client-reported.
keyTier.unknownTooltip: Not reported at verification (legacy enrollment or older client).

validation.invalidPhone: Use an international phone number with country code (example: +1 514 555 1234)

detail.editExpiresHint: Applies to the pending invitation window, not a separate post-verification lifetime.
detail.errorConflict: Someone else changed this enrollment. Refresh and try again.
detail.credentialsPreviewNotice: Technology preview: this screen shows the enrollment proof token, binding challenge, and QR together for convenience. Production deployments would typically deliver these through separate channels (e.g. email and SMS) for stronger assurance—automated email/SMS integrations are not part of this release. This hosted build is a demonstrator, not a production security baseline. Until then, consider capturing the QR with a screen capture or screenshot tool and emailing the image to the person enrolling, and sending the 6-digit binding challenge in a separate SMS to their phone using your usual channel.
detail.tokenHint: Share this token with the user to set up their EZKey mobile app.
detail.tokenNotAvailable: Token is not available for this enrollment.
detail.qrCodeHint: User can scan this QR code with the EZKey mobile app.
detail.deactivateIntro: Deactivating temporarily prevents authentication. The enrollment can be reactivated later.
detail.reactivateIntro: This enrollment is inactive. Reactivating will restore authentication capabilities.
detail.revokeIntro: Irreversible. Revoking permanently disables this enrollment. A new enrollment must be created for re-enrolment.
detail.revokeConfirmTitle: This action is PERMANENT. The enrollment will be irreversibly revoked.
detail.deleteIntro: Deleting an enrollment permanently removes the device association. The user will no longer be able to authenticate.
detail.deleteConfirmTitle: Are you sure? This action cannot be undone.
detail.revokedAlert: This enrollment has been permanently revoked.

help.proofToken: Cryptographic token used by the mobile device to bind to this enrollment.
help.bindingChallengeCode: One-time code the device must enter to complete enrollment.

lifecycleDialog.deactivateMessage: Temporarily deactivate this enrollment? The user will not be able to authenticate until reactivated.
lifecycleDialog.reactivateMessage: Reactivate this enrollment? The user will be able to authenticate again.

testAuth.title: Test Authentication
testAuth.intro: Trigger a live authentication request for enrollment {{name}}. The end-user will see a pending request on their EZKey mobile app.
testAuth.challengeHint: A 2-digit code is displayed here. The user must confirm the matching code on their device.
testAuth.contextMessagePlaceholder: e.g. Authorize payment of $500 CAD to a supplier (Montreal).
testAuth.demoMitmHint: Flags this attempt so the Auth API may return a tampered Pending body after signing (only when ezkey.demo.mitm-signature-enabled is true). For presentations — expect signature verification to fail on the device.
testAuth.demoMitmLiveHint: Demo MITM opt-in: this attempt is flagged. If Auth API demo mode is on, the Pending JSON may not match the integration signature.
testAuth.challengeHintLive: Show this to the user — they must confirm the matching code on their device.
testAuth.abandonHint: Close this dialog without cancelling the attempt on the server. The request stays active until it expires or the user responds on their device.
testAuth.doneAccepted: Authentication accepted! The user confirmed the request on their device. The enrollment is working correctly.
testAuth.doneRejected: Authentication rejected. The user declined the request on their device.
testAuth.doneExpired: Timed out. No response was received before the attempt expired.
testAuth.doneInvalid: Invalid attempt. The request was marked invalid — this may indicate a device binding issue.
testAuth.doneCancelled: Cancelled. The test authentication was cancelled.
